mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that directly boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 50,000 jobs month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.10%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.10%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.10% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7.0% indicates coordinated monetary policy and labor market strength that accelerates economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market improvement
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.10% and UNRATE < 7.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by robust housing market activity (HOUST > 900,000 units), consumer spending and related sector growth drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with HOUST above 900,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain strength that precedes stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 950,000 units, it signals immediate strength in consumer demand for housing and related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 950,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 900,000 units) and expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) indicates synchronized demand and supply growth that accelerates economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 900,000 and INDPRO > 100.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), restrictive monetary policy pressures equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.
